newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates signs $138 million loan for Boeing 777.
newsitem.headline: Emirates signs $138 million loan for Boeing 777.

text.p: Dubai-owned Emirates airline said on Sunday it had signed a $138 million, 12-year loan with a consortium of local and international banks for the fifth of seven Boeing 777 aircraft it has on order.
An Emirates statement said the loan is priced on a LIBOR floating rate basis at a margin of 50 basis points.
The funding deal is led by Emirates Bank International and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, it said.
Other consortium members are Abu Dhabi Investment Corporation, Barclays Bank, Banque Paribas, The Industrial Bank of Japan, Deutsche Kommunalbank, Ing Lease and ABN-AMRO Bank, it added.
The aircraft, the second of four long-range planes set to join the company's fleet fleet this year, will arrive in Dubai on May 16.
